card.name: The word to after used (definitions)
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "used" in dictionary-style or explanatory text, as in "is used to describe". It also fires weakly on "insufficient" or "useful" in the phrase "useful but insufficient proxy".

modes.label: used to + verb
modes.description: The word "to" after "used" when explaining how a term or item is applied.
modes.example: Outer space is a term used<< to>> describe everything existing outside of the Earth's

modes.label: useful but insufficient
modes.description: Evaluative adjectives in the disclaimer about uncorrected book text.
modes.example: please consider the following text as a useful but<< insufficient>> proxy for the authoritative book pages.
